articles.title: Delays not only domestic, but from abroad too: Defence Secretary on equipment orders
articles.summary: Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh expressed concerns about some Indian defence companies "overpromising and under-delivering" on equipment. He clarified this issue isn't exclusive to domestic firms, stressing the need for robust performance from all suppliers. This highlights challenges in defence procurement and the critical importance of accountability to strengthen India's indigenous defence capabilities and effectively reduce reliance on imports, crucial for national security.

articles.title: INDIAN ARMY HOSTS CHANAKYA DEFENCE DIALOGUE 2025
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence announced the commencement of the Chanakya Defence Dialogue 2025. Operating under the theme 'Reform to Transform - Sashakt, Surakshit Aur Viksit Bharat', this dialogue focuses on crucial defence reforms. It highlights India's commitment to enhancing its defence capabilities and ensuring national security, aiming to foster an empowered and developed nation.

articles.title: Betting trends that define the Champions League race
articles.summary: The UEFA Champions League stands as Europe's pinnacle club football competition. Its immense prestige and competitive nature make it a coveted aspiration for countless players and teams across the continent. Participating in this tournament represents a significant achievement and a dream come true for those involved in European football, highlighting its unparalleled status.

articles.title: Nifty’s December hit rate is 60% over 10 years on strong FII/DII trends. What’s in store for 2025?
articles.summary: The Nifty index opened the December series strongly, hitting a fresh lifetime high of 26,310.45 on Thursday after a 14-month wait. This significant surge reflects strong investor confidence and market optimism, with expectations that the positive momentum will continue. This economic indicator signifies robust performance in the Indian stock market, crucial for national economic health and growth prospects.

articles.title: HAL Chairman DK Sunil Denies Any Problem With Tejas Aircraft; Share Price Rebounds
articles.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd. (HAL) shares rose 1.16% to Rs 4,535, recovering from a 1.26% fall in the previous session. The stock's positive movement reflects market confidence in India's leading defence public sector undertaking. This financial performance is relevant for aspirants monitoring the health and investment in national defence manufacturing capabilities.

articles.title: Tejas has no issues, Dubai crash will have no impact on future of fighter jet: HAL chairman DK Sunil
articles.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) Chairman affirmed the Tejas light combat aircraft's absolute safety, stating a recent Dubai crash will have no impact on the indigenous fighter jet's future operational use. This statement aims to reassure stakeholders about the Tejas's reliability and continued deployment, which is crucial for India's domestic defence capabilities and air force modernization efforts.

articles.title: Amazon’s Black Friday deals are not to be missed, from AirPods to beauty buys
articles.summary: The article hints at an anticipated development from Amazon, signified by the phrase 'Alexa, grab my wallet.' This suggests a new voice-activated feature for Amazon's Alexa platform, likely designed to enhance shopping or payment processes through intuitive voice commands. articles.title: Huawei, ZTE seal 5G deals in Vietnam after US tariffs, as ties with China warm​
articles.summary: Chinese telecom giants Huawei and ZTE have secured substantial contracts for 5G equipment in Vietnam, signaling a strengthening of ties between Hanoi and Beijing. For SSB aspirants, this development highlights the evolving geopolitical landscape, where technological collaborations like this can signify shifts in international relations, regional power balances, and influence digital infrastructure security.

articles.title: Raksha Mantri & his Indonesian counterpart co-chair 3rd India-Indonesia Defence Ministers' Dialogue in New Delhi; Agree to further deepen defence ties
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence confirmed that India and Indonesia have reiterated their shared commitment to a free, open, peaceful, and prosperous Indo-Pacific region. Both nations emphasized strict adherence to international law and mutual respect as fundamental guiding principles for regional stability. This collaborative stance underscores ongoing efforts to maintain maritime security and foster a rules-based order, crucial for regional development and cooperation.

articles.title: Exclusive-Huawei, ZTE seal 5G deals in Vietnam after US tariffs, as ties with China warm​
articles.summary: Chinese telecom giants Huawei and ZTE have secured multiple contracts to supply 5G equipment in Vietnam this year. This development signifies Vietnam's increasing reliance on Chinese technology for its next-generation mobile networks. For SSB aspirants, this highlights evolving international technological partnerships and potential geopolitical considerations regarding digital infrastructure in Southeast Asia.

articles.title: Live content soon on Rs 2k phones with no data pack as D2M tech paves way
articles.summary: Indian mobile users, including over 200 million feature phone owners, could soon access live sports, Bollywood movies, and web series directly on their devices. Originating from New Delhi, this development suggests a new technology enhancing content accessibility without solely relying on internet data. This potential shift promises to democratize digital entertainment across the nation, expanding reach significantly.

articles.title: Putin says Russian army has surrounded Ukrainian city of Pokrovsk
articles.summary: Russian President Putin claimed forces control 70% of the encircled Ukrainian city of Pokrovsk. However, Kyiv's top general stated Ukrainian forces are pushing back hard, indicating intense and contested fighting. This highlights the volatile and fluid nature of military operations in this strategically important region, a key aspect of the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict.
